transport: Apple iPhone Mirroring wireless, CUA App API
scope: Ten real Spotlight calculation/conversion tasks. This tests bulk text input and visible-result verification through Mirroring. It does not test Calculator app taps, JEV, cross-app completion, or the native XCTest transport.
audio: Mac output mute verified on before session; no audio recording
timing: Warm focused-field input through a fresh screenshot/OCR result check. Reset/selection and result hold are outside task timing; setup_ms and frame request/completion timestamps retained. No fixed UI-settle sleep.
recording_method: Native CUA screenshot captures with request/completion timestamps; variable cadence around 2–3 fps, resampled to 25 fps for playback. Frames are actual phone images, not regenerated UI. Per-frame original hashes stay in the local private archive. Three-second result holds excluded from timings. Public videos preserve only result-card and query-bar regions; full recordings include reset and are local/private.

privacy_mask.meaning: Only these normalized source rectangles remain; captions are separate from native pixels.
